text.en: Label states no clear risk or has limited data; use only if needed, under medical advice.

pregnancy.quote: Risk Summary Available information from published randomized controlled trials with insulin aspart use during the second trimester of pregnancy have not reported an association with insulin aspart and major birth defects or adverse maternal or fetal outcomes [see Data] .

text.fa: برچسب: در شیردهی با احتیاط؛ متن برچسب را ببینید.
text.en: Label: use with caution while breastfeeding; see the label text.

lactation.quote: Risk Summary There are no data on the presence of NOVOLOG in human milk, the effects on the breastfed infant, or the effect on milk production.

text.fa: برچسب برای کودکان شرط، محدودیت سنی یا نکته دارد؛ جمله برچسب در زیر آمده است.
text.en: The label has conditions, age limits or notes for children; the label sentence is quoted below.

pediatric.quote: The safety and effectiveness of NOVOLOG to improve glycemic control have been established in pediatric patients with diabetes mellitus.

text.en: Label: use with caution in older adults, usually starting at the low end of the dose range.

geriatric.quote: Of the total number of patients (n=1,375) treated with NOVOLOG in 3 controlled clinical studies, 2.6% (n=36) were 65 years of age or over.
